about: Should you restart your phone every week. Factory #39, backlog row 43, slug restartphone. One hard idea: the NSA's Mobile Device Best Practices sheet says 'Power the device off and on weekly'; some spyware can't survive a restart (Kaspersky, Operation Triangulation, June 2023: 'does not support persistence'), so a reboot can clear it; but the NSA's own chart rates the weekly restart 'Sometimes prevents', and Kaspersky said phones 'may be reinfected after rebooting'; a restart doesn't close the hole, an update can (Apple iOS 16.5.1, June 21, 2023, credited Kaspersky); so update and restart weekly; Samsung Galaxy phones can Restart on schedule (Settings > Device care > Auto optimization > Auto restart, samsung.com/us). Sources read 2026-11-22, see BRIEF.md.
